faq.q: What is the origin of Seif?
faq.a: Seif is associated with Arabic. Seif is the Swahili form of Arabic سَيْف (Sayf), meaning 'sword'.
Yes — the underlying form سَيْف is Arabic.
Seif can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Seif should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Sayf is not a Quranic personal name.
